children: Shares of Tata Steel were trading marginally lower on the NSE on Monday morning, down 0.05 per cent at ₹173.72 as of 11.44 AM, after opening higher at ₹174.80. The stock touched an intraday high of ₹177.25 before paring gains, with sell orders outweighing buys — 63.56 per cent of the order book was on the sell side versus 36.44 per cent on the buy side. Traded volume stood at 186.42 lakh shares worth ₹326.77 crore.

The stock is in focus after the government released the draft National Steel Policy Vision 2047 for stakeholder consultation over the weekend. The policy targets crude steel production capacity of 604 million tonnes, per capita consumption of 302 kg, and exports of 45 million tonnes by 2047 — roughly double the goals set under the existing National Steel Policy 2017.

title: Tata Steel slips marginally as draft steel policy 2047 puts sector in focus
